description: Compare whole-protein vs catalytic-site sequence constraint across Saccharomyces sensu stricto orthologs of each GT71 paralog
code:
exec(open("aligner.py").read())
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
sc=json.load(open("gt71_seqs.json")); orth=json.load(open("gt71_orthologs.json"))
asg=pd.read_csv("gt71_ortholog_assignment.csv")
site=pd.read_csv("gt71_site_conservation.csv")
SITE2=[int(p) for p in site['Mnt2_pos']]

# For each Sc paralog, align to its orthologs in the 3 sensu-stricto species and measure
# (a) whole-protein identity, (b) identity at the 21 donor/metal-site positions (mapped via Mnt2 frame).
res=[]
t0=time.time()
for p in ["MNN1","MNT2","MNT3","MNT4","MNN2","MNN5"]:
    sub=asg[(asg.assigned==p)&(asg.species.isin(["S_mikatae","S_uvarum","S_eubayanus"]))]
    for r in sub.itertuples():
        o=orth[f"{r.species}|{r.acc}"]
        st=stats(sc[p],o)                       # Sc paralog vs ortholog
        m2p=stats(sc["MNT2"],sc[p])['corr']     # Mnt2 pos -> Sc paralog pos
        n_id=n_tot=0
        for pos in SITE2:
            q=m2p.get(pos)
            if q is None: continue
            oo=st['corr'].get(q)
            if oo is None: continue
            n_tot+=1; n_id += (sc[p][q-1]==o[oo-1])
        res.append(dict(paralog=p,species=r.species,acc=r.acc,
                        whole_pid=round(st['pid'],1),
                        site_pid=round(100*n_id/max(n_tot,1),1), n_site=n_tot))
print("elapsed",round(time.time()-t0,1))
d=pd.DataFrame(res)
print(d.to_string(index=False))
agg=d.groupby('paralog').agg(n=('acc','size'),whole=('whole_pid','mean'),site=('site_pid','mean')).round(1)
agg['site_minus_whole']=(agg['site']-agg['whole']).round(1)
print("\nMean across sensu-stricto orthologs (ortholog vs its S. cerevisiae counterpart):")
print(agg.to_string())
d.to_csv("sensu_stricto_site_vs_whole.csv",index=False); agg.to_csv("sensu_stricto_site_vs_whole_summary.csv")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.6))
order=["MNN1","MNT2","MNT3","MNT4","MNN2","MNN5"]
x=np.arange(len(order))
ax.bar(x-0.2,[agg.loc[p,'whole'] for p in order],0.4,color="#8fa6c4",label="whole protein")
ax.bar(x+0.2,[agg.loc[p,'site'] for p in order],0.4,color="#2f7d3a",label="21 donor/metal-site positions")
for i,p in enumerate(order):
    ax.text(i+0.2,agg.loc[p,'site']+1.2,f"+{agg.loc[p,'site_minus_whole']:.0f}" if agg.loc[p,'site_minus_whole']>0 else f"{agg.loc[p,'site_minus_whole']:.0f}",
            ha="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold",color="#2f7d3a")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(order); ax.set_ylabel("% identity to the S. cerevisiae protein")
ax.set_ylim(0,105); ax.legend(fontsize=9,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("Sequence constraint in Saccharomyces sensu stricto orthologs\n"
             "(S. mikatae, S. uvarum, S. eubayanus vs S. cerevisiae): whole protein vs catalytic site",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
